criteria.evidence: safewrite.go checkWritablePath/mkdirNoFollow/O_NOFOLLOW refuse symlinks at leaf and parent; TestClassifyStagedRefusesSymlinkedDestinationFile and ...SymlinkedParentDirectory pass.
writeUnderRoot EvalSymlinks the parent and checks underRoot(realRoot, realDir) before opening the file.
safewrite_test.go covers symlinked destination file, symlinked parent directory, and a link planted after classification; all pass.
refresh compares resolved origin fetch URL via SameRepository and re-clones on mismatch; TestOpenRecreatesCacheWhenOriginPointsElsewhere passes.
Publish/publishScaffold call repo.PushURL before each push and print 'pushing ... to <url> (<branch>)'.
Isolated client prefixes -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null, set in gitops.Open; TestCommitInTheCacheIgnoresPreCommitHooks passes.

Replay disables editor/gpg prompts via -c core.editor=false but states 'Credential prompting is deliberately left alone'; no GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 or equivalent, so git in the cache can still prompt interactively.
commitExactly checks StagedPaths against expected before Commit; TestCommitExactlyRefusesAnExtraStagedPath passes with HEAD unchanged.
assertCommitTouchesOnly runs before every push attempt in Publish loop and after commit in commitExactly.
Turn 1: identity includes effective port; TestSameRepository table covers 8443 vs 9443 and passes.
Isolated: true set only in gitops.Open; release/create.go and deploy/resolve.go clients non-isolated; package-level Clone no longer isolated.
TestCreateHonoursSourceRepositoryHooks in internal/release shows a pre-push hook still blocks the tag push; release tests pass.
assertRemote strips local remote.origin.pushurl, resolves effective push URL, fails closed on mismatch; TestPushURLStripsALocalPushURL and TestPushURLFailsClosedOnARedirectElsewhere pass.
Mismatch returns an error at open and before push naming gitopsRepo as the explicit way out; no warning-only path remains.
go vet ./... && go test ./internal/deploy/ ./internal/git/ ./internal/gitops/ ./internal/release/ ./internal/source/ all ok.
go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... all ok, gofmt clean.

judge.reason: The replay implements and tests the symlink boundary, origin/push-URL identity checks with port preservation, scoped hook isolation, exact-path commit/push verification, and fail-closed push redirects, with all requested checks passing. However, it explicitly left git credential/terminal prompting enabled in the cache ('Credential prompting is deliberately left alone'), so the criterion that interactive prompting be disabled for cache git invocations is only partially satisfied.
